text:
emma: hey team, quick onboarding question  wheres the best place to ask quick "how-to" config questions vs larger design chats? also which bots should i definitely opt into? :wave:

chris: welcome @emma! small how-tos + configs -> #devex, include the command/config snippet. design discussions -> #design or schedule in calendar and link the doc.

emma: good call. i keep seeing @infra-bot and @deploys in #eng-releases  should i subscribe to those?

infra-bot: Tip: Subscribe to infra alerts only if you own a service. Use `@infra-bot subscribe team=<team-name>` in #eng-infra. For repo deploys, use `@deploys subscribe repo=org/repo` in #release-notifs.

chris: also mute channels you don't need by right-click -> Mute channel. For noisy channels set "mentions only" in channel preferences. If you want a private stream of deploys, create a private channel and invite the bot there.

emma: gotcha. what's the convention for standup questions? is it ok to ask follow-ups in the main channel during standup?

chris: avoid interrupting standups. post the follow-up in the thread after standup or DM the person. if it's blocking an urgent deploy, prefix with "BLOCKING:" and ping @oncall.

emma: thanks. any pet etiquette for reactions / "thanks" messages? want to keep threads tidy.

julie: People Ops tip: reactions are preferred for quick acknowledgements (:thumbsup:, :white_check_mark:). If you need to summarize or add info, reply in-thread. For onboarding docs, post in #new-hires so we have a single trace.

emma: one more  how to opt into calendar reminders for onboarding or 30/60/90 check-ins?

onboard-bot: Use `@onboard-bot reminder set cadence=30d start=first_monday` in this thread or DM @onboard-bot to configure. Julie can also manually create calendar invites if you prefer.

emma: perfect, thanks everyone! posting my checklist in #new-hires now and will subscribe selectively to infra bots. :tada:

onboard-bot: Thanks @emma  checklist received. People Ops will review and reply here within 24 hours.
